  • Weighted point system for intelligent random link discovery

title: Project Exporter Pro — Universal Export Engine
tagline: Universal Export Engine for Web Applications
short_description: A self-contained JavaScript export engine supporting multiple image and document formats with Shadow DOM isolation.
detailed_description: Project Exporter Pro is an open-source, self-contained JavaScript export engine designed to handle multiple output formats including PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, and CMYK color space exports. The tool is built as a completely standalone component using Shadow DOM isolation for encapsulation, making it easily embeddable in any web project without style conflicts. The engine provides a clean API for programmatic exports and includes a live README documentation modal built into the interface. The project is published on GitHub as an open-source tool for the developer community and features comprehensive export options with quality controls, format-specific optimizations, and batch processing capabilities. The architecture emphasizes modularity, reusability, and zero external dependencies beyond core export libraries.
content:
About This Project

Project Exporter Pro is an open-source, self-contained JavaScript export engine I built for the developer community. It handles multiple output formats — PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, and CMYK — and is architected as a Shadow DOM Web Component, meaning it can be dropped into any existing project without style conflicts.

Why Shadow DOM?

Most export libraries either pollute the global stylesheet or require careful CSS isolation. By encapsulating the entire engine inside a Shadow DOM, Exporter Pro guarantees zero conflicts with the host application regardless of its CSS framework or custom styles.

Key Features

  • Multi-format export: PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, CMYK
  • Shadow DOM encapsulation — zero style conflicts
  • Fully self-contained, no external runtime dependencies
  • Built-in live README documentation modal
  • Clean programmatic API for integration
  • Quality control options per format
  • Batch export capabilities
  • Browser-native file download

Tech Stack

Language: Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 | Architecture: Shadow DOM, Web Components | Rendering: Canvas API | Export: Native browser APIs | Published: GitHub (open source)
project_timeline: Start Date: 2024 - Status: Published and maintained
